title: Albemarle Corporation Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026, cash was USD 1.632 billion, total debt was USD 1.877 billion, and diluted weighted-average common shares for the quarter were 136.212 million.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supplies current balance-sheet, debt, preferred-conversion, cash-flow, tax, production, and risk evidence for the common-equity review.
